title: A Fixed-Point Construction of the Elementary Transcendental Functions
summary: We present a unified fixed-point construction of the elementary transcendental functions, encompassing the real exponential, the complex exponential (sine and cosine), and the natural logarithm. Each function is characterized as the unique solution of a duplication identity established through the Banach contraction principle. These foundational identities are $e(2x)=e^2(x)$ for the exponentials, and $\log(x^{2})=2\log x$ for the logarithm.
